text:
yasmin Quick heads-up: PolarisCompute pinged — they can offer 5 L40s in us-east1 for a ~36h window starting tomorrow. We want to run a small end-to-end quantized model validation (latency + perf). Low QPS, ephemeral. Need infra + finance quick green. @felix any infra gotchas? :eyes:
felix Which pool would that attach to and any host-level networking needs?
yasmin Pool: rl-inference-smoke (ephemeral). No disk mounts, artifacts to s3. Network: we need egress < 300 Mbps to avoid throttles. Also prefer single AZ us-east1-c to reduce variance.
vendor-bot PolarisCompute note: allocation ETA ~18h. Requires vendor agreement token if spend > $1,500. Ticket PC-3344.
procure-bot Heads-up: token/PO required for allocations > $1,500. Submit: https://procure.redwood/forms/po-uplift?ticket=PC-3344
karen Finance check: we can do a one-off token or PO uplift with cost center and approver. Need estimated GPU-hours or NTE cap.
yasmin Estimate: 5 GPUs * 6h + 3h buffer = 33 GPU-hours. Polaris rate quoted at $30/hr => ~$990. Recommend cap $1.2k to be safe. Cost center: cc-909. Approver: @karen.
trevor Approved up to $1.2k for validation, conditional on: 1) auto-terminate at 12h, 2) telemetry enabled with pull to `perf/quant` dashboard, 3) egress limiter set to 300 Mbps. :white_check_mark:
felix I can open infra PR and add az=us-east1-c label + a network policy to cap egress. Will add nodeStartupTimeout=6m and an auto-terminate hook. Draft snippet:
```resource "redwood_alloc" "polaris_l40s_use1" {
  pool = "rl-inference-smoke"
  gpu = "l40s"
  count = 5
  window = "2026-09-05T02:00Z/2026-09-05T14:00Z"
  labels = { az = "us-east1-c" }
  owner = "felix"
  config = { egress_limit_mbps = 300, nodeStartupTimeout = "6m", auto_terminate_hours = 12 }
}
```
infra-bot Reminder: vault/HSM access not allowed on vendor nodes. If the validation needs private keys, use local dedicated pool.
yasmin Noted — no HSM usage for this run; we only need public test keys.
vendor-bot PolarisCompute: we'll hold the allocation for 18h pending PO form. Ticket PC-3344.
procure-bot PO form: https://procure.redwood/forms/po-uplift?ticket=PC-3344  tag @karen once filled.
karen I'll fill the form and issue token/PO once PR references cost center + cap. Expect processing in ~8h.
sre Please attach tail-latency tracing and tag `perf/quant` dashboard. If p95 latency regresses >25% tag me in #incidents.
felix PR will include smoke job that fails fast if node join >6m and emits canary metrics. Opening PR now and will assign infra review to @trevor and billing to @karen.
yasmin Thanks all  will kick the validation after PR + PO/token confirmed and post a one-line in #incidents if anything odd. :rocket:
